purpose: Reconstruct the published measurement chain of the 2002 Ascension Island HDAS seabed survey while explicitly separating measured/published facts from inference and unknowns. This artifact must not be used to reinterpret target identity without another JANUS council.

source_class_policy.EXPLICIT_NEAR_PRIMARY: Explicitly stated in contemporaneous HDAS/OCEANS technical material or DTIC abstract of the survey paper.
source_class_policy.EXPLICIT_SECONDARY_TECHNICAL: Explicitly stated in a later technical source reproducing or summarizing the original survey.
source_class_policy.INFERRED: Logically inferred but not explicitly documented for this survey; may not be promoted to fact.
source_class_policy.UNKNOWN: Not recovered from public sources reviewed in this pass.

overall_dates.note: The same source separately gives inshore operations as June 12-23, producing a one-day start-date discrepancy that is preserved rather than harmonized.

mission.value: Detailed geophysical seabed survey to identify hydrophone installation sites and low-risk cable routes from Ascension Island to the two proposed HDAS arrays.

hydrophone_site_boxes.value: 20 km x 20 km at each candidate site

minimum_offshore_corridor_width.value: 2 km from hydrophone sites toward shallow water, narrowing near landfall

survey_plan_defined_equipment_and_proces.note: The public overview says the May 2002 survey plan defined equipment and processing, but the plan itself has not been recovered.

dates.date_discrepancy: Overall survey start is separately reported as June 13.

coverage.value: shore facility to approximately the 50 m isobath

platform.value: small survey launch for shallow water work; abstract states depths <100 m

additional_surveys.scope: between proposed landfalls and MILS building

coverage.value: approximately the 30 m isobath to proposed acoustic array sites

south.value: approximately 115 km south of Ascension Island

platform.value: approximately 1200-ton survey ship for deep-water work

deepest_operating_context.value: full ocean depth capability is stated for the sensor suite
deepest_operating_context.note: This is a capability/context statement, not a recovered maximum sounding depth for a specific line.

near_real_time_processing.purpose: rapid assessment and revision of the survey route

supported_from_public_text: Map seafloor bathymetry and imagery at route/site-survey scale.
Delineate regional and seamount slopes relevant to cable/sensor placement.
Identify broad rough/hard/rocky seabed hazards using bathymetry and imagery.
Use multibeam backscatter as a seafloor-imagery/characterization product.
Provide shallow sub-bottom information where that channel was actually collected.
not_supported_without_primary_raw_or_geo: Exact coordinates or polygon of the Southern Seamount 'wishbone' feature.
Exact coordinates or polygon of central crags.
A quantitative pyramid or crater identity.
Raw sounding uncertainty, beam footprint, ping geometry, or survey-grid resolution.
Buried-object interpretation without exact sub-bottom coverage, model/frequency, resolution and raw/profile evidence.
Treating the historical ~2200 m southern site design estimate as final as-built seafloor depth.

explicit_nonfindings.note: Searches for DGPS/GPS, SeaBat, Simrad EM120/EM300, Klein, model/frequency, sound velocity and motion-sensor terms did not yield an Ascension-specific public statement. Generic cable-survey standards or unrelated Ascension cruises are not substituted.

supports: same survey-paper abstract facts as DTIC catalog

success_definition: Measurement provenance manifest frozen with explicit unknown fields and source classification, without filling missing instrument metadata by inference.
